sloka: राक्षसेन्द्र समाधूतम् तस्याः तत् वदनम् शुभम् ।शुशुभे न विना रामम् दिवा चन्द्र इव उदितः ॥३-५२-२२॥
transliteration: rākṣasendra samādhūtam tasyāḥ tat vadanam śubham ।śuśubhe na vinā rāmam divā candra iva uditaḥ ॥3-52-22॥

translations.english: Shaken up by the demon and deprived of Rama's company, Sita's beautiful face looked like the Moon during daytime without any glow.
